Any app can call itself \":client\". Thi: Any app can call itself ":client". This address tells you who you are really connecting.
The app will be able to read and edit co: The app will be able to read and edit content with your permissions. New entries are saved as drafts.

Voice, tone, audience and conventions of: Voice, tone, audience and conventions of your site, in Markdown. The AI assistant receives them at the start of every session. Left empty, the guidelines from the config file apply.
Managed in the file config/mcp.php of yo: Managed in the file config/mcp.php of your site. Changes here have no effect.
The addresses of the AI apps that may co: The addresses of the AI apps that may connect, such as https://claude.ai. Only apps on these addresses can register and send editors back after they sign in. Add http://localhost to allow desktop and command-line tools on the editor's own computer.
Lets the assistant delete entries, terms: Lets the assistant delete entries, terms and assets for editors who may delete them. Content the assistant reads can contain text that tries to steer it, and a deletion cannot be undone.
:value is not an app address. Enter only: :value is not an app address. Enter only the scheme and host, such as https://claude.ai or http://localhost.
